chars.R: RACHID: a young man wearing a faded red hoodie, black tracksuit trousers with white side stripes, white sneakers.
chars.L: LAMIA: a young woman wearing a long lilac cardigan over a white top, light blue jeans, a small gold handbag.
chars.K: THE RIVAL: a tall young man wearing a black leather biker jacket, dark sunglasses on his face, black jeans and heavy black boots.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A sunny street in Beni Mellal, Morocco. RACHID sits on his small old scooter in the foreground on the left, frozen in shock with his mouth open, staring across the street at a cafe terrace where LAMIA sits at a small table laughing with THE RIVAL. Comic shocked moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan cafe terrace with green plastic chairs and mint tea glasses. LAMIA and THE RIVAL sit close together at one small table, LAMIA laughing happily at something he says, he leans back confidently.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: RACHID hides behind a palm tree trunk on a Beni Mellal sidewalk, peeking out with one eye, angry and jealous, fists clenched, a cafe terrace visible behind.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A waiter in a white shirt serves plates of food and two coffees to LAMIA and THE RIVAL at their cafe table; LAMIA smiles at the food. Warm Moroccan cafe interior with tiled walls.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: LAMIA and THE RIVAL sit side by side at the cafe table, each with one earbud, watching a series together on one phone that he holds; the phone screen glows but shows no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: RACHID sitting on his small old scooter at the curb, sweating and hesitating, one hand on his head, torn between going in or not, a Moroccan cafe in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Seen from behind RACHID's shoulder (he is in the foreground at the bottom left, peeking around a wall), LAMIA and THE RIVAL just sit calmly at the cafe table watching the phone, doing nothing else. RACHID looks confused.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On a Beni Mellal street, a huge shiny black sport motorcycle is parked right next to RACHID's tiny rusty old scooter. RACHID stands between them, looking at the big motorcycle with jealous wide eyes and a sad face.
